name: Loan Data 145
definition: Specifies the loan data details in case of a securities lending transaction.

DeliveryByValue.name: Delivery By Value
DeliveryByValue.definition: Specifies whether the transaction was settled using the Delivery-by-Value (DBV) mechanism.

CollateralDeliveryMethod.name: Collateral Delivery Method
CollateralDeliveryMethod.definition: Specifies whether the collateral is subject to a title transfer collateral arrangement, a securities interest collateral arrangement, or a securities interest with the right of use.

Term.name: Term
Term.definition: Indication whether the transaction is open term or, i.e. has no fixed maturity date, or fixed term with a contractually agreed maturity date.

AssetType.name: Asset Type
AssetType.definition: Indication of the type of assets subject of the transaction.

RebateRate.name: Rebate Rate
RebateRate.definition: Interest rate (rate agreed to be paid by the lender for the reinvestment of the cash collateral minus lending fee) paid by the lender of the security or commodity to the borrower (positive rebate rate) or by the borrower to the lender (negative rebate rate) on the balance of the provided cash collateral.

LoanValue.name: Loan Value
LoanValue.definition: Specifies the loan value, that is the quantity or nominal amount multiplied by the price.

LendingFee.name: Lending Fee
LendingFee.definition: Fee that the borrower of the security or commodity pays to the lender.

UniqueTradeIdentifier.name: Unique Trade Identifier
UniqueTradeIdentifier.definition: Unique trade Identifier (UTI) as agreed with the other counterparty.

EventDate.name: Event Date
EventDate.definition: Date on which the reportable event pertaining to the transaction and captured by the report took place. In the case of action types valuation update, collateral update, reuse update, margin update, the date for which the information contained in the report is provided.

ClearingStatus.name: Clearing Status
ClearingStatus.definition: Indicates whether clearing of contract has taken place.

TradingVenue.name: Trading Venue
TradingVenue.definition: Venue of execution shall be identified by a unique code for this venue.

MasterAgreement.name: Master Agreement
MasterAgreement.definition: Reference to master agreement under which the counterparties concluded a documented transaction.

ExecutionDateTime.name: Execution Date Time
ExecutionDateTime.definition: Indicates the date and time when the contract was executed.

ValueDate.name: Value Date
ValueDate.definition: Date on which the counterparties contractually agree the exchange of securities or commodities versus collateral for the opening leg (spot leg) of the secured financing transaction. In the case of rollover of open term repurchase transactions, this is the date on which the rollover settles, even if no exchange of cash takes place.

TerminationDate.name: Termination Date
TerminationDate.definition: Termination date in the case of a full early termination of the reported transaction.

GeneralCollateral.name: General Collateral
GeneralCollateral.definition: Indication whether the transaction is subject to a general collateral arrangement. -‘true’ shall be populated for general collateral. General collateral specifies a collateral arrangement for a repurchase transaction in which the security lender may choose the security to provide as collateral with the cash provider amongst a relatively wide range of securities meeting predefined criteria.|-‘false’ shall be populated for specific collateral. Specific collateral specifies a collateral arrangement for a repurchase transaction in which the buyer requests a specific security or commodity (individual ISIN) to be provided by the seller.
